issue: Inconclusive native tab-switch visibility pause in headless automation
changes: Synchronously clear autoplay timer on hidden state, window blur and pagehide
Gate timer callback on active-page ref, document.hidden and document.hasFocus
Restart a full interval on visibility/focus/pageshow return with activity-version dependency

verification.method: External preview browser; controlled document.hidden override and visibilitychange events, plus synthetic blur/focus events, followed by actual DOM slide-counter assertions

limitations: This deterministic lifecycle regression is not a claim of physical-device or native tab-switch testing. Earlier responsive swipe check used a drag gesture because the remote browser did not expose a touch API.
